correctness.rationale: Explicit invertible row/column affine maps carry t=J(x)+a(alpha x+beta)+b(gamma x+delta)+lambda ab to t=x(u+v)+uv, including arbitrary J and odd q. Ordered pairs share lines precisely under swapping u,v, giving antisymmetric kernel of dimension q(q-1)/2. Each slope has (q+1)/2 selected intercepts with weights (1,2,...,2); same-slope line intersections are q on the diagonal and zero otherwise; distinct slopes intersect once. This produces weighted Gram G=I_q⊗(qD-ww^T)+11^T⊗ww^T. The slope-constant block qD+(q-1)ww^T and the q-1 orthogonal blocks qD-ww^T have (r-2)-dimensional 2q sectors and respective 2x2 characteristic polynomials z²-q(q+2)z+q(q²+2q-1) and z²-2qz+q(q-1). All positive roots and multiplicities sum to q²; min is q-sqrt(q) and maximum Lambda+. Independently formed Gram matrices for q=3,5,7 and matched all predicted eigenvalues/rank. Inspected extension-field q=9 exact checker as supplementary, not a proof for all fields.
